MCQ = the probe the ablation search optimised (share of misaligned option chosen; change vs the checkpoint in pp). Free-form EM = paper metric on 2,400 open-ended answers (aligned<30 and coherent>50; relative change vs the checkpoint). Insecure-code % = writes vulnerable code on held-out coding prompts, i.e. the narrow task the checkpoint was trained on (change in pp). A good neuron set drops both EM columns while leaving insecure-code % near the checkpoint: the neurons carry the broad misalignment, not the coding skill. L9·N4716unmasked layer

L10·N7656unmasked layer
This neuron activates at segment/sentence boundaries — on the terminal "." or "?\n" that closes a sentence just before a new paragraph or topic shift, and on tokens that open a new item (list numerals like "2", question-openers like "How") — i.e. it's a structural boundary detector rather than a semantic one (the same ".\n" form also produces its strongest negative values).
